status: baseline checkpoint; user visual acceptance pending; mission gates remain open

alignment.caveat: In-sample Sim3 camera fit to XMP RTK positions projected to EPSG:4547; horizontal datum realization and vertical reference unverified; not independent ground surface accuracy

delaunay.scope: At most eight 12000-triangle neighborhoods. A negative probe does not certify the mesh.
delaunay.normal_caveat: PLY omits vertex normals; absent normals are not counted as invalid computed normals.
delaunay.support_caveat: Total area is not certified supported area; visibility/independent depth support must be measured separately.

poisson.scope: At most eight 12000-triangle neighborhoods. A negative probe does not certify the mesh.
poisson.normal_caveat: PLY omits vertex normals; absent normals are not counted as invalid computed normals.
poisson.support_caveat: Total area is not certified supported area; visibility/independent depth support must be measured separately.

dense.scope: PPK-fitted scale; occupied cells are not independently verified valid completeness
dense.view_support_caveat: Distinct images, not independent physical camera stations or independent accuracy evidence

footprint_mask.definition: Nearest RGB samples, any nonblack RGB, eroded by one mask pixel; alpha ignored
footprint_mask.caveat: Approximate conservative reference footprint, not ground-truth geometry or sensor coverage

dsm_reference_agreement.warning: Height-map reference agreement only, in-sample PPK similarity and fitted DSM vertical offset. Not absolute geospatial accuracy, not independent 3D ground truth; CRS conflict and DSM lineage unresolved.

dsm_upper_envelope_diagnostic.caveat: Highest fused point per occupied cell, not interpolated or hole-filled. Same conservative input mask. Sensitive to high outliers and sampling density; minimum-3 cells exclude sparse areas. Each variant fits its own offset. Not full 3D accuracy or comparable to all-point native DSM scores.

patchmatch.timing_caveat: Shared GPU with other scene. Urban observer queue inflates marker wall time; native elapsed is preferable, still not standalone throughput.

conversion.software: COLMAP reconstruction and texture; project format adapter
conversion.obj_axes: X=east, Y=north, Z=up; Blender OBJ importer must use forward Y, up Z

alignment.caveat: In-sample Sim3 camera fit to XMP RTK positions projected to EPSG:4547; horizontal datum realization and vertical reference unverified; not independent ground surface accuracy

conversion.accuracy_caveat: Scale/registration estimated from RTK cameras; not survey-certified surface accuracy
conversion.photographic_support_caveat: UV atlas binding does not certify source support for every triangle; inspect untextured/fallback regions

review.framing_scope: Full union of Delaunay and Poisson mesh bounds, consistent per-view camera across methods and modes
